summary: @NurseMcHurt imagine in people gave up on books after thirty years or said, "That is just for the monks," Took 800 years to spread and it was always those with power who wanted to keep literacy from the masses. Web is no different and I ain't ready to give up yet.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @NurseMcHurt imagine in people gave up on books after thirty years or said, "That is just for the monks," Took 800 years to spread and it was always those with power who wanted to keep literacy from the masses. Web is no different and I ain't ready to give up yet.
